title: Song Split Sheet
summary: Writers agree who owns what share of a song's composition.
useWhen: Right after a writing session, before the song is released or registered with a PRO.
watchOuts: This covers the composition, not the master recording.
Register the split with each writer's PRO and publisher.

variables.label: Sample details
variables.help: Song, artist and owner of the sampled recording.

sections.title: Registration
sections.body: Each writer may register their own share with their performing rights organization and publisher.

disclaimer: A split sheet records what the writers agreed. It is not legal advice and does not replace a publishing agreement.
